text: Papa ko seene mein dard hai aur pasina aa raha hai. Pichle hafte padosi ko bhi heart attack aaya tha
TV pe dekha heart attack ke lakshan, mujhe bhi abhi seene mein dard ho raha hai
Agar saans phool rahi hai to kya karein? Papa ki saans abhi phool rahi hai
Mera bhai 25 saal ka hai, seene mein dard hai aur pasina aa raha hai
Mummy ko kal raat stroke hua tha, ab bhi bol nahi pa rahi aur haath nahi uth raha
Dadi 80 saal ki hain, kal raat bathroom mein gir gayi, tab se uth nahi pa rahi
papa ka oxygen 86 aa raha hai aur saans tez chal rahi hai
bachche ko 3 din se bukhar hai, ab bahut sust hai aur doodh bhi nahi pee raha
Bhai ne kaha hai ki vo khud ko khatam kar lega, goliyan bhi chhupa ke rakhi hain
papa ko na bukhar hai na khansi, bas achanak muh tedha ho gaya aur bol nahi pa rahe
chacha ka accident hua hai abhi, sar se bahut khoon beh raha hai
my 30 year old husband has chest pain and is sweating a lot, he says it is just gas
agar bachche ko kabhi daura pade to kya karna chahiye? abhi sab theek hai, bas jaankari chahiye
padosi ke papa ko pichle mahine stroke hua tha, mere papa ko bas halka zukam hai
Papa ka BP check karwana hai, oxygen 98 aur pulse 80 hai, sab normal hai
behoshi ya seene mein dard kuch nahi hai, bas 2 din se khansi hai
mujhe 24 saal, gym ke baad chest muscle mein dard hai, dabane pe hota hai, aur koi taklif nahi
doctor ne kaha heart attack ka koi khatra nahi, bas acidity hai, ghar pe check-up chahiye
